caption: The drawing features a round plate, illustrated from both a top-down and a side profile view. The top view shows the plate with a broad rim, decorated with a repeating floral pattern including pink, blue, and purple flowers with green leaves. The central part of the plate displays a yellow basket containing an arrangement of large pink roses with green leaves and interspersed blue and purple flowers. The rim design consists of alternating clusters of pink and blue flowers, interwoven with green foliage. The side view below reveals the plate’s shallow depth and white base, with the floral rim pattern wrapping around the edge, visible in pinks, blues, purples, and greens. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the drawing is rendered using colored pencils or watercolors, giving the artwork soft, blended hues.
title: Plate
